case_title: EVELYNG MARTINEZ VS. TSYMING CALVIN CHONG

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY MARTINEZ, EVELYNG AS TO DEFENDANT CHONG, TSZMING CALVIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-25-2019 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING CALENDAR OF MAR. 25, 2019. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF PRESENT WITH SPANISH INTERPRETER WITHOUT PROOF OF SERVICE. DEFENDANT ALSO PRESENT IN OPEN COURT, AND WAIVED SERVICE PROCESS. PARTIES WERE PLACED UNDER OATH AND TESTIFIED. AFTER HEARING THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED, THE COURT TAKES THIS MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION. PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBIT RETAINED BY THE COURT. JUDGE JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA. NOT REPORTED.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-25-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MARTINEZ, EVELYNG RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHONG, TSZMING CALVIN $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,075.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
